title: Mistral Large 4 awaits its licence
summary: Mistral Large 4 is live in preview at a half-price launch rate, with open weights promised by the end of October and no licence named yet. Also today: Mistral's CPU-friendly Timestral forecasting models, the December second AI Act marking deadline, and Google's Universal Cart reaching US shoppers.

title: Argon's Pricing Cliff, Ecosia Leaves Mistral
summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is now broadly available, but its introductory API price doubles on December first. Also: Mistral Large 4 in preview, Ecosia's switch from Mistral to open models on European servers, new evidence that LLM judges are over-trusted, and the December second AI Act marking deadline.
